pages.speaker: npc
lines: Lucas: It's Team Galactic! They took the Pokémon of the lake... This woman... I lost to her, but just barely! Mars: That face...! It brings back bad memories! I'm talking about the windworks! I caught a whole lot of trouble for that little incident. What's with that look on your face? You do remember me, don't you? Fine, whatever. I'll tell you who I am again! I'm Mars, one of Team Galactic's Commanders. So, what is it? Are you some lovey-dovey couple to the rescue? Not a chance! Not even a teeny one! You're all going down!
